triples.tail_surface: speed is to be reduced with constant torque (fuel index) down to 90% power
triples.evidence_text:
For 4-stroke engines, the following is to be performed without indication of surging:

i)   With maximum continuous power and speed (= 100%), the speed is to be reduced with
                      constant torque (fuel index) down to 90% power.

triples.tail_surface: speed is to be reduced to 72% while keeping constant torque (fuel index)
triples.evidence_text:
ii)  With 50% power at 80% speed (= propeller characteristic for fixed pitch), the speed is to
                      be reduced to 72% while keeping constant torque (fuel index).

triples.tail_surface:
engine working characteristic established at workshop testing of the engine is to be
                      plotted into the compressor chart of the turbocharger
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 发动机工作特性绘制到增压器压气机图谱
triples.evidence_text:
i)   The engine working characteristic established at workshop testing of the engine is to be
                      plotted into the compressor chart of the turbocharger (established in a test rig). There is to
                      be a surge margin in the range of 15% at engine full load conditions

triples.tail_surface: Sudden fuel cut-off to at least one cylinder
triples.evidence_text:
ii)  Sudden fuel cut-off to at least one cylinder is not to result in continuous surging and the
                      turbocharger is to be stabilized at the new load within 20 seconds.

triples.tail_surface:
power is abruptly reduced from 100% to 50% of the maximum
                      continuous power
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 功率从100%骤降至50%最大持续功率
triples.evidence_text:
iii) No continuous surging and the turbocharger is to be stabilized at the new load within 20
                      seconds when the power is abruptly reduced from 100% to 50% of the maximum
                      continuous power.

triples.tail_surface:
operated in the
            presence of the Surveyor
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在验船师在场情况下运行
triples.evidence_text:
Before final acceptance, each turbocharger, after installation on the engine, is to be operated in the
            presence of the Surveyor to demonstrate its ability to function satisfactorily under operating conditions and
            its freedom from harmful vibrations at speeds within the operating range.
